text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"I'm ashamed to have lost again, sir. 
However――"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I will deliver results, without fail! A 
victory that surpasses this defeat...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"So please, have faith in me... I want us 
to walk together again!!"
choice_data_list: That's what I should be saying.

out!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Thank you so much for your kind words.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It might take some time, but I'll work 
harder than ever before, so please don't 
hold back on me...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
To put up a fierce fight against my 
rivals, I'm gonna retrain myself starting 
right now...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Until the next race, I won't waste a 
single second...!"
